checks.title: A test exercises this contract or invariant
evidence_required: the test that exercises it, or the searched test locations
falsifiers: a test elsewhere (integration, e2e) exercises it
validation_methods: search tests for callers of the code
an approved coverage run as supporting evidence
checks.limits: A missing test is a test gap (no-test), never a bug finding.

checks.title: The test asserts the contract, not incidental output
falsifiers: another assertion in the test pins the contract
validation_methods: read the assertions against the contract
targeted mutation of the contract within budget
checks.limits: Code that runs but is not asserted is wrong-assertion or no-assertion.

checks.title: Mocks and fixtures behave like the real boundary
evidence_required: the real boundary behavior (contract, schema, recon evidence)
falsifiers: a contract test keeps the mock in line with the real boundary
validation_methods: compare mock behavior with the contract
checks.limits: Unknown real behavior is a recon gap, not a test gap.

checks.title: CI actually collects and runs the test
evidence_required: the test's collection (paths, markers, skips, xfail)
falsifiers: CI runs the suite that contains it
validation_methods: read CI config and test markers
checks.limits: No CI configuration in the repository: record a not-in-ci test gap citing where you searched; never assume CI runs it.

checks.title: Failure, invalid input and recovery paths are tested
evidence_required: the test (or none) that exercises it
falsifiers: a test triggers the path and asserts its outcome
validation_methods: search tests for the error and its handler
checks.limits: Migrations, startup, IPC and infrastructure are not excluded by default.

checks.title: The test is deterministic (no time, order, network or randomness dependence)
evidence_required: how the test controls it (or not)
falsifiers: the input is fixed or injected
validation_methods: an approved repeated run within budget
checks.limits: Flaky markers, retries and skips are evidence, not proof.
